segments.ja150:1.3: Tameva ghāsaṃ kurute, byaggho sañjīvako yathāti.
segments.ja150:4.1: Sukhamedhati daṇḍavaro ca puna, lasi vāladhi pañcamarādhavaro;
segments.ja150:4.3: Samahodadhi kattika bondi puna, caturaṅgulabyagghavarena dasāti.
segments.ja150:7.3: Āsīso itthivaruṇaṃ apāyi, littavaggena te dasa;
segments.ja150:7.5: Parosataṃ haṃci kusanāḷi [haṃsi sarikkhaṃ (sabbattha)], asampadaṃ kakaṇṭakavaggo.
